hypotheses.construction_plan: Define the one-parameter kernel K(x) = V(x)*G0(x)*V(x). Instantiate K at x=p and x=q; the raw expression is the sum K(p) + K(q).
required_assumptions: V and G0 are defined at both p and q.
hypotheses.rationale: The two addends are syntactically identical up to the parameter name p versus q, so they are specializations of one shared parameterized kernel.
